Day by day

Thu 21 OctArrivalNightlife
Arrive, settle in, Trastevere by night.
  • Evening in Trastevere: cobbled lanes and trattorie.
  • End at the piazza by Santa Maria in Trastevere.
Fri 22 OctCultureMarket
Colosseum and the Forum, then Testaccio.
  • Colosseum and Roman Forum MUST-SEE BOOK AHEAD: timed entry only, no closing day.
  • Official tickets release exactly 30 days out at 9am Rome time. Mark the date.
  • Testaccio Market in the afternoon: locals outnumber tourists.
  • Testaccio is best 9 to 11am, Mon to Sat, closed Sunday.
Sat 23 OctCultureMarketScenic
Vatican, Trionfale Market, then Trevi and Pantheon.
  • Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel MUST-SEE BOOK AHEAD. Closed Sundays, except the packed free last Sunday.
  • St Peter's is free. The dome climb needs its own ticket. Closed Wed mornings.
  • Trionfale Market, 10 minutes' walk: lunch stop, Mon to Sat, closed Sunday.
  • Evening walk to the Trevi Fountain and the Pantheon.
Sun 24 OctMarketTravel
Porta Portese flea market, then an evening flight from FCO.
  • Porta Portese runs Sunday only, about 7am to 2pm. It fits departure day.
  • Campo de' Fiori market is Mon to Sat, closed Sunday, so skip it.
  • Evening flight home from FCO.

Know before you go

  • Many markets close Sunday: Testaccio, Trionfale and Campo de' Fiori.
  • No Italian public holidays fall on Oct 21 to 24, so hours are normal.

Festivals & Events

  • LIKELYFesta del Cinema di Roma, about Oct 13 to 24. The stay should catch its closing days.
  • HIGH CONFIDENCERomaeuropa Festival runs Sept to mid Nov and covers the whole stay.
